text:
Asha (CSM): Hey team — Oxley Labs onboarding kickoff. They want pilot go-live in ~6 weeks. Need quick alignment on primary stakeholders, measurable success criteria, and any early renewal risks. I’ll run a 30m sync Friday 10am PT. Can folks add availability?

Miguel (Solutions Eng): I can do Fri 10. Heads up Oxley is heavy on vector search use cases — we'll need embeddings perf and rerank checks.

Priya (Customer Success): Added to calendar. Stakeholders: Leah (ops/PO), Marcus (security), and Dev lead is Rohan. Leah wants clear adoption KPIs, Marcus needs SSO + data residency proofs.

Tom (Product): From product side, success criteria recommendation: 1) API latency P95 < 450ms for typical 512-token requests, 2) 80%+ classification accuracy on their golden set, 3) integration docs completed and 3 internal users trained.

Sarah (Eng): Noted. Need to confirm their request volume profile. If bursty we should enable reserved capacity for pilot. Also will check current model variant for cost/latency tradeoffs.

Jenna (SE): I can draft a short integration checklist and a demo playbook for the pilot. Will include a quickstart script and sample prompts.

Asha (CSM): Renewal risk flags: customer mentioned legal review timeline at 8w and they flagged SSO and SOC2 evidence. Marcus contact is on the invite — @Marcus, can you share required docs? If we can close evidence gaps early, renewal risk drops a lot.

Priya (Customer Success): I'll follow up with Marcus. Also putting in enablement cadence: weekly 30m office hours + biweekly product review with Leah.

Miguel (Solutions Eng): For engineering tasks, propose this near-term timeline:

Week 0: Kickoff + scoping (this week)
Week 1: Integration + SSO test
Week 2: Pilot data ingestion + embeddings sanity
Week 3: Performance tuning + KV cache config
Week 4: Internal enablement + acceptance tests
Week 5: Pilot soft launch
Week 6: Post-launch metrics review + handoff

Asha (CSM): Perfect. Can everyone add blockers to this thread by EOD so I can share the plan with Leah?

Tom (Product): Blocker: need their sample dataset access and an internal point of contact for data mapping.

Sarah (Eng): Blocker: If they require private deployment (on-prem/VPC) we need procurement notice — that pushes timeline. Confirming whether their data policy requires it.

Jenna (SE): Blocker: need their test API key and example queries. I'll send a template request to Leah after sync.

Priya (Customer Success): I'll ask Leah for the dataset and confirm Marcus's SSO requirements. Also propose a 5-question pulse survey we can run after week 2 to capture early feedback.

Asha (CSM): Good — action items from this thread:
- Priya: confirm dataset + Marcus SSO docs (due Tue)
- Jenna: send API/key request template (due Mon)
- Miguel/Sarah: prepare perf/runbook plan (due Wed)
- Tom: finalize success metric definitions with Leah (due Wed)
- Asha: send Fri 10am invite + agenda (sent)

deploy-bot: Calendar invite created: "Oxley Labs Onboarding — Kickoff" Fri 10:00 AM PT.

Miguel (Solutions Eng): One more note — suggest we instrument a simple quality eval harness (small gold set) before Week 3 so we can quantify regressions during tuning.

Asha (CSM): Agreed. Priya, can you own the gold set collection with Leah?

Priya (Customer Success): Yep, will coordinate and aim to have a 200-example gold set by end of Week 1.

Tom (Product): Also let's capture the adoption KPI targets in the thread so they’re explicit (e.g., 50 weekly active users within 4 weeks of pilot, 70% task completion on flows). I'll draft and post tomorrow.

Asha (CSM): Thanks everyone. If no more blockers, I’ll lock the timeline and share the external kickoff note to Leah after Fri's sync. Please reply here with any last-minute items. :thumbsup:
